title: Round 11 / ECDLP-38: new technique toward conjecture C* (tight x-only interpolation degree)
question: Find a proof technique beyond translation-annihilator zero counting (method barrier L2) to show that the minimal degree of g with g(x(kP)) = k on 1 <= k <= N is >= alpha*N with alpha > 1/3, e.g. via Newton divided differences on the nodes x(kP), resultants with division polynomials, or a dimension count of Riemann–Roch spaces with prescribed values; or prove that no such improvement holds in general.

sources.title: Coppersmith, Shparlinski: On polynomial approximation of the discrete logarithm and the Diffie-Hellman mapping, J. Cryptology 13 (2000) 339-360 (abstract level)
Kiltz, Winterhof: On the interpolation of bivariate polynomials related to the Diffie-Hellman mapping, Bull. Austral. Math. Soc. (2004) (abstract level)
Kopparty, Kothary, Shankar: ePrint 2026/2621 (preprint, unchecked; sharper Coppersmith-Shparlinski bound)

claims: D0 (proved, elementary): at the cusp nodes x0/k^2 all Newton divided differences are nonzero: target k^2: c_j=(-1)^j (j+1)!^2 x0^-j; target k in char 0: c_j has sign (-1)^j (mean value theorem for y^{-1/2}); in char p>2N, c_{N-1}(0) is nonzero mod p unless p divides an explicit integer Num_N (33/6751 bad (p,N) pairs for p<400).

Theorem D (proof attempt, not formalized/reviewed): for p>2N, the set of (A,x0,y0) in F_p^3 (nodes distinct) with c_{N-1}=0, i.e. deficit D(N)>=1, has size <= w_N p^2, w_N=(N-1)[N(N+1)(2N+1)/6-(N+2)/2]=N^4/3+O(N^3), for target k^2 always and target k when p does not divide Num_N; so generically mindeg=N-1 exactly for N <~ (3p)^{1/4}. Method: cuspidal (additive) degeneration + division-polynomial weight/degree count + Schwartz-Zippel.
Corollary D' (proof attempt): in characteristic 0, c_j != 0 for all j generically, so generic mindeg(N)=N-1 for every N.

Conjecture C* for N comparable to p and alpha>1/3 beyond N~p^{1/4}: NOT proved; the method loses a factor N^4 against the observed 1/p deficit frequency. Only generic statements are possible (L3 CM deficit; real curves with c_2=0).
next_action: Independent review of Theorem D (weight count, Schwartz-Zippel on the good locus); determine the true degree/irreducibility of Num=0 (Lang-Weil) and a second-order cusp expansion for p in Bad_N; test Num_N zero-locus point counts; formalize D0 in Lean.
